rationale: The stock has gapped down ~8% on an earnings miss and is trading in a highly volatile, wide-range session with only 2 one-minute candles of data available, making directional conviction extremely low. The bid-ask spread of 158 bps creates an immediate structural disadvantage, and the price is sitting at 16.5% of today's range with no clear stabilization pattern — the low of $103.23 was just tested. With insufficient price action history to identify a reliable entry level and extreme intraday volatility (range already ~$13 on a ~$105 stock), the risk/reward is unfavorable in either direction.
